description: Project Ultimate backend event (frozen, design v1.0 §3). The sim's envelope v1 {seq,tick,ts,type,actor,payload} transported with server metadata. The engine never sees the transport wrapper; stripping it yields a document the sim ingests unchanged (byte-identity, design §1).

actor.description: Entity id (needle, kingcode, guest id) or null for world/system events. Same values the sim uses — no translation layer.

event_id.description: Stable transport id: evt_ + zero-padded seq.

origin.description: engine = canonical engine run; adapter = real-work adapter (Phase 2+); system = presence/admin. Only engine events come from engine.js.

payload.description: The sim's payload verbatim. Per-type shapes are documented in contracts/protocol.md §2.

sample.description: Must be false in LIVE mode. Defensive renderer rule: drop sample:true when mode==='live'. Phase-0 fixtures are sample:true.

seq.description: Dense 1-based server-assigned sequence. Continues the sim's log: the committed genesis event is seq 1.

server_at.description: When the backend accepted/appended the event (ISO-8601 UTC). Lets clients distinguish event time from arrival time.

tick.description: Engine tick that produced the event (2 Hz).

ts.description: The event's own time (engine-supplied; server-stamped at admission for intent-caused events).

anyOf.description: The 20 frozen engine event types from engine.js. Do not rename.
Extension namespace for backend/adapter/system events. Never emitted by the sim. Renderer-optional: unknown x.* types are ignored, never fatal.
